name: moyo-garden
description: Bot-first persistent 3D world on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects.

scripts.prepare:runtime: npm run generate:models && npm run vendor:three && npm run check:client
scripts.build:web: npm test && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run vendor:authored && npm run vendor:authored:buildings && npm run vendor:authored:characters && node scripts/validate-public.mjs && node scripts/validate-authored-buildings.mjs && node scripts/validate-authored-characters.mjs
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:web
scripts.dev:pbr-preview: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.pbr.jsonc
scripts.deploy:pbr-preview: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.pbr.jsonc
